Dandiya Dhamal October 17, 2026- Entertaining Navratri Dandiya Garba Event

About this Event

Utsav Entertainment & Band Baaja Entertainment Present: Dandiya Dhamal 2026
A Night of Dandiya, Raas, Garba & Bollywood Beats!
Dandiya Dhamal 2026
Get ready for an unforgettable evening of vibrant music, colorful attire, and non-stop dancing! We warmly invite the DMV community to join us for “Dandiya Dhamal 2026” a spectacular celebration of Indian Gujarati folk dance, tradition, and modern flair.
Inspired by the iconic dance festivals of Gujarat known as NAVRATRI, Dandiya Dhamal is one of the BIGGEST Garba/Dandiya events in the area, hosted in a large venue space!
Live DJ SVP & DJ Shetul will be spinning your favorite Garba, Dandiya, and Bollywood tracks with a professional-grade sound system ensuring the energy stays high all night long.
Highlights Include
Traditional Garba & Dandiya with a cultural and Bollywood twist
A grand finale Bollywood Dance Party in the last hour
Music featuring top hits from various Indian artists
A welcoming, family-friendly environment for all age groups
Affordable ticket pricing through support from our local business partners
Come dressed in your best traditional attire and dance the night away with friends, family, and the local community. Whether you're a seasoned dancer or a first timer, this event promises something for everyone!
We can’t wait to celebrate with you all. Let’s make this a night to remember!
Terms & Condition:
1. Tickets are Non-Refundable and Non-transferrable.
2. You must have Sulekha ticket document and/or email.
3. We may ask verification of the person who purchased the ticket.
4. Kids 2 and above needs tickets.
With love,
Team Utsav & Band Baaja Entertainment
